# HR and People Operations playbooks

Each playbook is a default order. Adjust it to the request: drop skills the request does not need. Every output carries the not-legal-or-employment-advice notice and the assumed jurisdiction. Sensitive matters (terminations, investigations, harassment or discrimination complaints, whistleblowing, workplace injuries, immigration) skip the playbooks: HR and legal first.

## 1. Hire for a role

| Step | Skill | Skip when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `hr-job-description` | An approved ad and rubric already exist |
| 2 | `hr-interview-kit` | An approved kit already exists |
| 3 | `hr-recruiting-pipeline` | No applications yet |
| 4 | Correction cycle | Fix flagged wording in the ad, rubric and questions |
| 5 | `hr-offer-letter` | No candidate has been chosen by a person yet |

Example: "We're hiring a customer support lead." The ad draft drops "young, energetic team" and "native speaker", the rubric has three must-haves and four weighted should-haves, and the interview kit maps each competency to one stage. The report lists the pay transparency rule for legal to confirm and says that the hiring manager decides who to interview.

## 2. Onboarding plan

| Step | Skill | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `hr-onboarding` | Uses the company's checklist if provided |

Payroll setup goes to Finance and Accounting; account setup to IT when available.

## 3. Performance review cycle

| Step | Skill | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `hr-performance-review` (self-assessment template) | Start of the cycle |
| 2 | `hr-performance-review` (manager drafts and language check) | Per manager |
| 3 | `hr-performance-review` (calibration prep) | By employee code |
| 4 | Correction cycle | Rewrite vague or biased language |

Ratings, promotions and pay changes are decided by people. Pay questions go to the compensation review playbook.

## 4. Compensation review

| Step | Skill | Skip when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `hr-compensation-analysis` | Never for this playbook |
| 2 | `hr-policy-handbook` | The pay policy does not need updating |

Unexplained equity gaps go to HR and legal before any action.

## 5. Policy update

| Step | Skill | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `hr-policy-handbook` (explain or draft) | Legal minimums marked for review |
| 2 | Correction cycle | Apply the fairness check |

## 6. Org plan

| Step | Skill | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `hr-org-planning` (plan or report) | Aggregate, coded data only |

Any option that reduces or changes existing jobs stops here and goes to HR, legal and leadership.
